action: CERT Polska relays the vendor's advice to upgrade CAST Imaging to a newer version than 3.6.2. General advice: until then, limit network access to the Imaging web interface.
exec: CERT Polska lists eight flaws in CAST Imaging, including an authentication bypass and unauthenticated Keycloak email changes; the vendor says newer versions fix them.
geo_basis: advisory names no place for the vendor
plain: CERT Polska reports several security flaws in CAST Imaging, software that analyses application code. They include an authentication bypass and flaws that let a logged-in user read files. The vendor says newer versions fix them.

key_findings: CERT Polska lists eight CVEs (CVE-2026-109857 to CVE-2026-109864) in CAST Imaging; only version 3.6.2 is confirmed affected and other versions may be too.
CVE-2026-109857: the TenantFilter class trusts the X-ISSUER-LOCATION header, allowing administrator impersonation.
CVE-2026-109859 allows unauthenticated email change of Keycloak users; CVE-2026-109861 is a hard-coded token.
Two path traversal flaws (CVE-2026-109858, CVE-2026-109860) and three authorization flaws are also listed.
The advisory does not say any flaw is exploited; the vendor says newer versions fix them.
recommendations: Upgrade to a newer version than 3.6.2 as advised by the vendor.

summary: CERT Polska published an advisory on November 18 covering eight vulnerabilities in CAST Imaging, including an authentication bypass through a trusted header, unauthenticated Keycloak email changes, a hard-coded token, path traversal and missing authorization checks. Version 3.6.2 is confirmed affected. The advisory reports no exploitation; the vendor says newer versions fix the issues.
title: CERT Polska reports eight vulnerabilities in CAST Imaging, including authentication bypass

validation.note: CERT Polska advisory (a national CSIRT, primary) read in full; one publisher only. Reporters credited: STM Cyber.
